title: The Halfway Report: Pain, Luck, and One Team That Won't Lose
body:
We're 7 weeks in (Week 8 is waiting on Monday night). Some of you are good at this. Most of you are not. Let's get into it.

👑 NIEMS777 (13-1): #1 in wins, #1 in points (1,245). On pace to take both $25 bonuses AND the $300. At this point the other nine of us are just paying NIEMS's rent. Somebody grow a pair and beat this team.

🧙 Orc King (10-4): 2nd in points, opened with 206 and has been beating people's asses ever since. The only team in this league that NIEMS should be even slightly worried about. The rest of you are background noise.

🍀 Dart Vader (10-4): 6th in points with a 10-4 record. Won games by 7.7, 8.4, and 8.2. That's not a fantasy team, that's a guy who found a four-leaf clover in a horseshoe up his ass. The regression is coming and we'll all be watching.

💥 Blowup Dollz (8-6): 4th in points. Won the single ugliest game of the year, 115-101 in Week 6. Both teams should have been fined. A win's a win, but that one was disgusting.

🥊 The Knockout (7-7): Dropped the two highest scores of the season (209 and 211) back to back, then shit the bed with a 101 two weeks later, the lowest score anyone has put up all year. Jekyll-and-Hyde roster. Nobody knows which team shows up each week, including The Knockout.

🐶 thurmdog (6-8): DEAD LAST in points (989) and currently holding the 6th and final playoff spot. Your commissioner, everybody. Worst team in the league, built the website, controls the bonus tracker. No, there will not be an investigation. Yes, you should be concerned.

📉 Finbraum67 (5-9): The only team to beat NIEMS777 all year (Week 1). Has gone 1-5 since. Peaked in September like a high school quarterback. Still telling people about that one game.

🐂 Sammy the Bull (5-9): 9th in points. One game out of a playoff spot, which is less a compliment to Sammy and more an indictment of thurmdog. Currently getting absolutely bent over by Orc King in Week 8, 210-115. Thoughts and prayers.

🐦 The Bird Reich (4-10): 5th in points but the MOST points against in the league (1,250). Lost Week 1 by 0.68. Every single opponent saves their career game for you. Either you're cursed or the fantasy gods just think you're a loser. Possibly both.

🍼 Breast Milk (2-12): Won Week 1 by 0.68 points and has lost six straight since. That 0.68 is carrying this franchise harder than any player on the roster. "It's a dynasty league, I'm rebuilding." Sure, buddy. Rebuilding from what?

💰 MONEY CHECK
• 1st ($300), 2nd ($100), 3rd ($50): decided in the playoffs
• Reg season 1st place ($25): NIEMS777, 3 games up
• Most reg season points ($25): NIEMS777, 62 points ahead of Orc King
• Everyone else: $0 and a bruised ego

7 weeks left. 6 playoff spots. The worst offense in the league is holding one of them and also runs the league. Set your damn lineups.
